description: The surfaces, free volumes and live media bodies find routes through.

domains.description: Finite rectangular domains, each compiled from the world's deterministic solid field, as authored; a region-bound domain's extent is read through Of.

items.description: One finite navigation grid compiled from the world's collision and optional medium truth. Its extent is either authored (Origin, Width, Depth, and a surface's probe band or a volume's layers) or taken from a placement's region (Region), so a place and the ground its walkers route over are one authored box; Of resolves the second form into the first, and every reader of a domain's extent reads it there.

name.description: The stable domain name referenced by navigated producer targets.

kind.description: Whether cells follow ground, free 3D space, or a live medium.
kind.title: WorldNavigationKind

x-enumDescriptions.Surface: A 2D grid whose Y values are sampled from solid ground.
x-enumDescriptions.Medium: A 3D grid constrained to one live fluid-medium field.

cellSize.description: The square cell width in world units.

agentRadius.description: The solid-clearance sphere radius. A medium domain also keeps this whole volume submerged.

arrivalDistance.description: How close a body must come before advancing to the next waypoint.

maxExpandedNodes.description: The hard A* expansion budget for one route search; zero for the domain's cell count, every cell in one route.

maxPathNodes.description: The hard stored-waypoint budget for one route.

origin.description: The center of cell (0,0,0), relative to Parent when present and world-space otherwise; for a surface domain, resolved world Y is the ground-probe baseline. Absent beside a region.

width.description: The number of cells along the frame's X axis. Absent beside a region.

depth.description: The number of cells along the frame's Z axis. Absent beside a region.

region.description: A static placement whose box region is the domain's extent: its floor plan grown by Margin on every side gives the origin, width and depth, a surface probes its ground over the region's whole height (the baseline at its centre, the probe band its half height above and below), and a volume fills its height with layers. Its centre and half extents, less the margin, must fall on the cell grid.

margin.description: How far a region-bound domain reaches past its region's floor plan on every side, in world units, so neighbouring districts share cells and a route crosses between them. Zero without a region.

layers.description: The number of cells along world Y; surface domains require one.

connectivity.description: The volume neighbour set; ignored by surface domains.
connectivity.title: WorldNavigationConnectivity

probeUp.description: For a surface domain, the ground-search distance above origin Y.

probeDown.description: For a surface domain, the ground-search distance below origin Y.

agentHeight.description: For a surface domain, the clearance capsule height.

maxStepHeight.description: For a surface domain, the greatest adjacent height delta.

maxSlopeDegrees.description: For a surface domain, the greatest adjacent slope.

medium.description: For a medium domain, the named lattice field that cells must remain inside.

shared.description: Whether bodies navigating this domain follow shared goal fields: one field per goal over the domain's network, derived once and read a step at a time by every body heading there, in place of a route search per body. False keeps independent bounded A* searches, each within this domain.

parent.description: Optional static placement frame. Origin and grid axes are local to that frame; probes remain vertical. The frame must be undistributed and unit scale.

network.description: The network the domain joins. Domains join where they share a cell only when their networks match, so a route or goal field crosses from one district's pavement to the next but never onto a road of another network. Absent joins the one unnamed network.

area.description: The area type of the domain's cells no area marks, one of AreaTypes; absent leaves them unmarked, costing one under every profile.

items.title: WorldNavigationDomain

areaTypes.description: The area type names the world's areas, domains and profiles use, in a stable order. The engine gives no type a meaning: a type costs what each profile says.

areas.description: Marked volumes in precedence order: a cell takes the type of the last area holding the point a body standing on it stands at, else its domain's own Area.

items.description: One marked navigation area: a volume whose cells take an area type. Exactly one of Placement and Region is authored.

type.description: The area type, one of AreaTypes.

placement.description: A static placement whose Region is the area's volume, so one authored region both senses bodies and marks the ground under it.

region.description: The area's own volume in world space: a sphere of Radius or a box of HalfExtents about Center, turned by YawDegrees.

items.title: WorldNavigationArea

profiles.description: Named cost profiles a navigated producer target selects (Profile). A target with no profile pays one for every area.

items.description: A named navigation cost profile: what one kind of agent pays to cross each area type. A step costs its length (and the route search's clearance surcharge) times the multiplier of the area it steps onto.

name.description: The name a navigated target's profile selects.

costs.description: Each priced area type's multiplier, positive and at most MaxAreaCost; a type left out, and an unmarked cell, cost one.

exclude.description: The area types the agent never steps onto. A body already standing on one may step off it.

items.title: WorldNavigationProfile

title: WorldNavigationSection
